title: Result ingestion lanes
description: Bounded admission lane queue depth, throughput, rejections, NACKs, crashes, and incomplete sync runs across serviceradar-core nodes. Each chart is one metric split by the lane tag.

panels.title: Pending items
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_pending_count time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Pending item occupancy for each bounded core ingestion lane.

panels.title: In-flight items
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_in_flight_count time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: In-flight item occupancy for each bounded core ingestion lane.

panels.title: Pending bytes
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_pending_bytes time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Pending byte occupancy for each bounded core ingestion lane.

panels.title: In-flight bytes
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_in_flight_bytes time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: In-flight byte occupancy for each bounded core ingestion lane.

panels.title: Admitted
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_events_admitted time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Admitted interval deltas published by RuntimeMetrics, summed per lane.

panels.title: Rejected
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_events_rejected time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Rejected interval deltas published by RuntimeMetrics, summed per lane.

panels.title: Accepted completions
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_terminals_accepted time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Accepted completion deltas, summed per lane.

panels.title: Not-accepted completions
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_terminals_not_accepted time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Not-accepted completions per lane, including queue-wait timeouts, sweep cancellations, worker failures, and persistence failures.

panels.title: Crashes
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_events_crash time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Worker crash deltas per lane. A deadline kill is a timeout, not a crash.

panels.title: Incomplete sync runs
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_events_incomplete_run time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:sum series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Sync ledger checks that did not finalize, summed per lane.

panels.title: Queue wait (ms)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_queue_wait_ms time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

panels.title: Execution (ms)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_duration_ms time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Worker execution gauges per lane. Lane, sweep, and sync all publish duration_ms.

panels.title: Acknowledgement (ms)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:result_ingestion_acknowledgement_ms time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:tags.lane limit:500

display_config.caption: Latest per-lane metric samples persisted from metrics.ingestion_lanes.
